answer: Continuous physical-presence attestation. Each agent identity must periodically answer a challenge routed through a co-located hardware anchor whose clock drifts measurably and whose radio fingerprint varies with local terrain. A pearl of random timing is embedded per round. Verification spots must span a river basin and a meadow sensor grid, so one operator cannot answer two challenges simultaneously. Each fake identity costs a duplicate anchor plus field placement; attacker pays full hardware and site cost per identity.
